answer: Graduated throughput with time-locked bonds resists sybils. Each new identity escrows a bond and starts in a meadow: an admission zone where per-epoch yield is capped near zero. Throughput grows only with age and attested work - like orchard trees, identities fruit after seasons, not at signup. N sybils lock N bonds and wait N growth cycles before attack value beats one honest agent, while that capital sits idle and slashable; fraud burns the bond. Reputation is a mesa, reachable only up the long slope of verified work, no cliff to free-climb. Mass fabrication is capital- and time-negative.
